Scientific boundaries

These are straight geometric rays through both assumed transparent layers. Glass does refract and reflect; the model does not account for that. The original sensor ring and source L1 furniture are included.

At 3.5 m the illustrative outside protective layer is ~7.36 cm ALON-density solid and the inside pressure assembly is ~3.86 cm fused-silica-density solid. These are mass/density illustrations only, not validated thicknesses for impact resistance or airtight strength.

The 35 cm minimum inter-layer gap is a gross 1D shell envelope clearance. There is no certified ring/frame installation, structural pressure glazing, ballistic law, scattering or optical throughput model.
